Summary: Oman and Iran have agreed to establish a joint working group to discuss the future management of navigation through the Strait of Hormuz, including services provided in the waterway and associated costs. In a joint statement, the two countries said the group, formed between their foreign ministries, would continue dialogue on issues related to the strait and seek an agreement in line with international standards. The statement followed talks in Muscat where both sides pledged to continue co-operation on maritime safety, freedom of navigation and regional stability.

Summary: Pinned: #Video | Between Friday and Saturday, more than 120 people were killed in South Lebanon and the Bekaa. A truce, theoretically in force since April 17, has never been respected, neither by Israel nor by the pro-Iranian Hezbollah. At the al-Najdi al-Chaabiyé hospital, at the entrance to Nabatiyé, the medical staff tell us the unspeakable of the last few days: nights of incessant strikes, mutilated wounded, families coming to identify their loved ones. Mohammed Nasser, head of the morgue, talks about the hundreds of bodies received in recent months, including very young children. Despite an announced ceasefire, fear remains. The inhabitants are returning little by little, clear
